subject: Need quick eyes on the export error
text: Hi team, our nightly export keeps failing at the third step because the source folder changes name late at night, so the job cannot find it. I think the fastest fix is to add a fallback path pointing to the archived folder. If that does not work, we can switch to the shared sync folder and schedule the job a little later. I tested both options, and the fallback seems less disruptive. Please tell me which approach you want me to deploy before tonight.
